# TB Solutions
> The front office for the trades. Nick Byrd, Pottstown, PA. Serving Chester County, Montgomery County and the 422 corridor.

TB Solutions runs the front office for plumbing, HVAC and electrical shops: an AI receptionist
that answers when the owner cannot and books the job, Google Local Services Ads management,
Google review automation, and job-booking websites. Prices are published; nothing is on a contract.

## Services
- [Never Miss a Call](https://tbsol.net/services/ai-receptionist-for-contractors/): An AI receptionist that answers in your company name when your line rings out, books the job into your arrival windows, and texts you. $497 setup, $197/mo. $497 setup ($297 for the first five shops), $197/month.
- [Google Guaranteed Setup](https://tbsol.net/services/google-local-services-ads-management/): Google Guaranteed setup or migration, the account rebuilt, budget capped, and junk calls disputed weekly so you get the credits back. $497 setup, $147/mo. $497 setup ($297 for the first five shops), $147/month.
- [Review Engine](https://tbsol.net/services/google-review-automation/): Every finished job gets a text asking for a Google review, timed and worded right, one tap. Unhappy customers route to you first. $97/mo, no setup fee. no setup fee setup (no setup fee for the first five shops), $97/month.
- [Job-Ready Website](https://tbsol.net/services/websites-for-contractors/): One fast mobile page built to turn a homeowner holding a phone over a leak into a booked call: click-to-call, service area, reviews, a form that texts you. $497 build, $47/mo. $497 setup ($497 for the first five shops), $47/month.

## Trades served
- [plumbers](https://tbsol.net/for/plumbers/): water heater leaks, burst pipes, sewer backups, no hot water and clogged mains.
- [HVAC companies](https://tbsol.net/for/hvac-companies/): no heat, no cooling, frozen lines, thermostat failures and furnace lockouts.
- [electricians](https://tbsol.net/for/electricians/): dead outlets, tripping breakers, panel work, burning smells and partial power loss.

## Guides
- [What a Missed Call Actually Costs a Contractor](https://tbsol.net/guides/what-a-missed-call-costs-a-contractor/): The arithmetic on missed calls for a small plumbing, HVAC or electrical shop: how many you miss, how many book elsewhere, what it is worth over a year.
- [Why Contractors Lose Weekend Calls](https://tbsol.net/guides/why-contractors-lose-weekend-calls/): If your Google profile says closed Saturday you still get Saturday calls. They go to voicemail. What the hours field does, and how to cover weekends.
- [How Much Does an Answering Service Cost a Plumber?](https://tbsol.net/guides/answering-service-cost-vs-receptionist/): What a plumber or HVAC shop really pays for an answering service in 2026: per-minute, per-call and flat plans, the fees off the plan page, what a receptionist costs.
- [Google Local Services Ads for Plumbers: How It Really Works](https://tbsol.net/guides/local-services-ads-for-plumbers/): What a plumber pays per lead on Local Services Ads, the Oct 2026 missed-call charge, the dispute button, LSA vs regular Google Ads, and what the badge takes in PA.
- [AI Receptionist vs Answering Service: Which Fits a Shop?](https://tbsol.net/guides/ai-receptionist-vs-answering-service/): AI receptionist or a human answering service for a plumbing, HVAC or electrical shop: what each one does on a call, where each wins, and the PA recording rule.
- [How to Get More Google Reviews for Contractors, Legally](https://tbsol.net/guides/how-to-get-google-reviews-contractors/): How a plumbing, HVAC or electrical shop gets a steady run of Google reviews: when to ask, the text to send, the templates, and the Google and FTC rules that bite.
- [Google Local Services Ads for HVAC: Season by Season](https://tbsol.net/guides/local-services-ads-for-hvac/): Local Services Ads for an HVAC shop: what a lead costs, what the budget does in a heat wave, tune-up leads, the 24-hour hours trap, and what changed in 2025-26.
